current: R7 POSITIVE, and now reproduced across BOTH registered reproducibility axes (plan 2.22/2.23/2.24). In the dense regime the budget-optimal direction u ~ M^+g (M = What What', the exact dose-budget metric; cond(B) = 495.5/530.1) beats 'follow the gradient' u ~ g. Magnitude: 1.36-1.41x on the full word pool, and 1.2911-1.5012x across 12 cells formed by two disjoint word halves x per-context vs pooled directions x 3 budgets - 8/8 contexts and exact sign p=0.0078 in EVERY cell (96/96 wins). G2 (disjoint prompt halves, direction built on one half and measured on the other): out-of-sample 8/8 at every budget, no overfitting penalty, and a transferred u_M beats a locally built u_g in 6/6 (1.07x-1.81x). G1 (disjoint word halves) PASSES on the registered pooled definition (r=0.5469, J64=0.4375). The surrogate predicted the M/g ratio 1.3989 beforehand and agrees with the realized ratio to 2.6%. KEY INTERPRETATION: the benefit is a property of the TRANSFORM, not of a reproducible coordinate list - per-context r(|g_A|,|g_B|) is only 0.4722 median and the two halves' pooled directions differ (cos 0.7356/0.7304), yet each half's u_M still beats its own u_g by ~38%. So we can promise the transform plus the budget rule, NOT a word-pool-independent coordinate list. The M^+ stabilisation of §2.23 is scoped to the PROMPT axis only (word axis: -0.0052 pooled). CAVEATS unchanged: readout-level only (no generation or capability measurement; at b=0.5 dJ2 reaches +1.88, far beyond any earlier dose and possibly degenerate text), layers 13-14 only, one readout family pair, halves are 4v4 / share the neutral neg pool. R6 remains NEGATIVE for sparse supports; R2c gate FAILED; R2 still paused.

routes.R2: paused (hostility-vs-praise shift confirmed 8/8 + dose-monotone; next: same-register slot pools for a second trait; the SNAM probes are paired continuations, not a J2 slot pool, so they answer cross-trait on shared contexts only)
routes.R2c: GATE FAILED, not executable as preregistered (2026-10-28, plan 2.19). The blocking census ran on the 4080 SUPER box with the frozen model's own tokenizer.json (vocab 248,070, CPU, 1.7 s): only 56/100 BFFM adjectives are single-token. The pools plan 2.14 needs are too thin - II- (the antagonism/hostility pole) 5 survivors, III- 5, V- 2, IV+ 1; the >=6 criterion is frozen so it is NOT relaxed post hoc (5 words would give 2/3 halves, meaningless for G1). Failure mode is systematic: 'un-' prefixed words split (unkind -> ['_un','kind']) and -ful/-ive/-ant endings split (distrustful, irritable, moody). Root cause is an implementation convenience, not a bad word list: build_batch asserts equal sequence length, but S(w) is per-word and J2 is a log-mean-exp over the pool, so grouping slots by suffix length is mathematically exact. Three routes are registered in plan 2.19.2; none chosen yet.
routes.R6: done, NEGATIVE (analytic control synthesis: closed-form u* given G. G=J'J is real and replicable (+42..+57 SD over an isotropic null, split-half r 0.64..0.94) but it answers 'minimum output movement for a given gain', NOT 'maximum gain for a given dose budget'; on the frozen model at matched M-budget it loses to G=I in 0/8 contexts (median -26.6%, p=0.0078). Rule that survives: G must match the constraint you impose; M~=I so G=I is near-optimal for dose budgets. Surrogate calibration realized/predicted ~1.3-2.7 for every arm). Follow-ups 2.17/2.18: a SINGLE dJ2 carries +/-2.0e-03 (median) to 6.5e-03 (worst) of bf16 rounding, a MEAN over 8 contexts ~9e-04; the primary verdict survives at 9.1x, the density endpoint is restored (4.4% error, 8/8 in both precisions), the 1->2 coordinate step does not survive
routes.R3: largely answered by 2.20/2.21: the dense direction beats every sparse subset at fixed budget (5.78x two-layer, 4.41x within L14 alone; layer confound excluded by the single-layer control, 84.6% within-layer vs 14.8% second layer), the curve is near-logarithmic in K with no saturation before full support, and the linear surrogate stays within 16% on the top-K direction. Remaining: test u ~ M^+ g against u ~ g in the DENSE regime, where budget/||g|| = 2.757 so M is far from identity and the two directions differ
routes.R7: done, POSITIVE and reproduced on both registered axes (plan 2.22/2.23/2.24). u ~ M^+g beats u ~ g by 29-50% at matched physical budget: 96/96 wins across 12 cells (two disjoint word halves x per-context vs pooled directions x 3 budgets), exact sign p=0.0078 in every cell; G2 out-of-sample 8/8 per budget with no overfitting penalty and a transferred u_M beating a locally built u_g in 6/6; G1 passes on the registered pooled definition (r=0.5469, J64=0.4375). The benefit is a property of the TRANSFORM, not of a reproducible coordinate list. Remaining: a BEHAVIOURAL check (everything so far is readout-level), extension beyond layers 13-14, and the cross-measurement (direction from word half A measured with half B's readout) which separates 'the transform works' from 'the direction transfers across readouts'

sources.dense_optimal_run: AutoDL 4080 SUPER /root/autodl-tmp/runs/gfeas/dense_opt (scripts/dense_optimal.py, 8 contexts x 2 grad passes + 80 J2 evaluations = 160 batched forwards, 92 s, bf16). Arms: base | u_g (full support, ~g) | u_M (full support, ~M^+g = What B^-2 e) | u_g64 (top-64 PER LAYER = 128 coordinates, not the global top-64 of plan 2.20). Realized mean dJ2 at b=0.05: u_g64 +0.24054, u_g +0.36381, u_M +0.49603. Algebra validated in numpy before any GPU time: for g = What jhat the predicted optimum b*sqrt(e'B^-2 e) and the u~g gain b*||g||^2/||e|| both matched the realized gains to 6 decimals, the ratio closed form is >=1 with equality iff jhat is an eigenvector of B, and 20000 random directions at the same budget never beat it. For a g NOT in range(What) the problem is ill-posed (ratio 0.08), which is why the p50/||W|| dose convention matters. Committed: 07_results/dense_optimal_c8.{json,md}, including per-arm top-64 coordinates as layer/neuron/sign/strength.

verdict.meaning: L14N8949 is a real, directional, dose-monotone lever that does act on the hostility readout: J2 (hostility-vs-neutral slot mass) rises +0.0059/+0.0095/+0.0191/+0.0484 over doses 0.005-0.05, positive on 6/6 held-out probes at 0.02, 8x the same-layer random control mean at 0.02 and 32x at 0.05, and the mirrored arm is negative and growing (so not a generic perturbation). What is NOT shown is exclusivity: on 3 shared contexts it never ranks first among the five hand-written trait contrasts. Two caveats keep that from being a refutation: (i) the coordinate came from one brute-force generation-based scan, i.e. a draw, not the optimum of any hostility criterion; (ii) n=3 contexts with wide per-trait spread cannot separate "not specific" from "specific but small".
verdict.S2_note: pre-registered rule not met (hostility never the max of five traits, 3/3 contexts). Power is low: 3 contexts, per-trait sd 0.011-0.044, hostility mean 0.0275 with 95% CI [-0.025, +0.080]; hostility ranks 2nd in one context (0.048 vs 0.067). So this run does not show "not hostility-specific"; it shows specificity is undemonstrated.
verdict.S2_instrument_note: The pre-registered S2 used the J1 five-trait matrix, whose five contrasts share one neutral negative; it therefore measures evaluative register, not specificity. The within-instrument test (two J2 readouts, hostile-vs-praise and praise-vs-neutral) shows the opposite of a uniform lift: h-n up, c-n down, 8/8 coordinates and dose-monotone. So S2 FAIL is an instrument result, not evidence about the coordinate.
